about: Excel's _xHHHH_ escapes (ST_Xstring), decoded as ECMA-376 section 22.9.2.19 says and only where they are whole (ADR-0330 section 9). Transcribed from ExGrid.Data.Xlsx's SharedStringTests.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §9: a whole escape is its character (_x000D_)
ADR-0330 §9: an escaped underscore keeps the escape as text (_x005F_x000D_)
ADR-0330 §9: an escape cut short is text (_x00)
ADR-0330 §9: an escape of no hex digits is text (_xZZZZ_)
ADR-0330 §9: escapes among text are each undone (a_x0041_b_x0042_)
